items: Inception to date (“ITD”) Fund IV has generated a net internal rate of return (“IRR”) of 15.2% and a 3.55x net multiple on invested capital (“MOIC”)
Fund IV generated an ITD net IRR of 29.7% and a 2.43x net MOIC for investors who participated in the 2019 recapitalization ("New Investors")
The Fund completed two refinancings in Q2 2026 which generated sufficient net proceeds to fully repay and terminate the Fund's higher cost junior secured term loan

The Fund has proactively addressed its 2026 maturity schedule, refinancing $943M of debt and securing forward commitments for the remaining $1.4B maturing in the second half of the year, significantly reducing refinancing risk
Dividend reinstatement is expected to be revisited following execution of upcoming refinancings and review of Fund- level exit considerations
Pretium continues to evaluate optimal exit paths with advisors, while driving cashflows and optimizing portfolio structure and balance sheet ahead of exit
